message: The other day, I was in the kitchen, happily sautéing veggies, when I remembered that little nagging voice in my head that kept saying, "Check the smoke alarm!" I rolled my eyes, but hey, I finally did it—and wouldn’t you know? The battery was dead! 😳 I had that smug 'I told you so' moment when I realized I could’ve been in a real pickle if something had gone wrong. So, if you haven't checked yours lately, consider this your friendly reminder! Sometimes, a little preparedness goes a long way. What’s your latest ‘I told you so’ moment?
